## History

Small Anne Cordelia was known to the world of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for two happy years. Before ending her teaching career, she spent time in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret reminiscing about past memories and discussing local gossip and her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). On her wedding day, she woke up happily at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), got married in the orchard, and left for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) following a joyful reception.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P31](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), +3 more_
